prompt: Create an original 90 second melodic chiptune instrumental composition for science explainer, tutorial and educational narration. Mood: curious, clear, thoughtful. Instruments: pulse-wave lead, triangle bass, noise percussion. Style: clear arpeggiated game-like melody and concise rhythmic phrases. Tempo approximately 136 BPM; G major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep the lead sparse and the midrange uncluttered for spoken narration. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.
